author: profbananaslug
body:
nobody asked for this or even thought it was possible, but i made a tournament edition of core test.
features:
-larger
-3 (three) more water blocks per side
-fences to support the core, for added realism so that the immersion is not broken
-cores now have faces, i thought they needed to look a bit friendlier. (the cores are still black, no racism please)
-two trees (terraforming)
-3 (three) iron blocks per side for armor and whatnot (although to make a crafting table you'll need to get wood from the two trees)
-two chests filled with useful items at spawn(one has 9 stacks of thin snow, 2 stacks of lily pads, 3 (three) stacks of ladders, 2 stacks of fences, 64 doors, and a stack or so of skeleton heads. the other chest has 4 tnt and stained glass panes based on the team [red team has yellow glass planes and blue team has lime glass planes])
-an unnecessary elevated area on each side with an moderately inconvenient ladder
-a 3 (three)x2 hole on each side (leading to the void[and presumably death])
-two barricades on each side to keep the bowspam down
-a four-wide ditch down the middle to add some depth
-a bridge in the middle with a gapple spawner and an arrow spawner (they spawn like 4 of each every 3(three)0 seconds, couldn't figure out how to make it just one)
-a wool room on each side because why not?
-spawn kit is slightly different, has an iron sword, infinity bow, efficiency-something diamond pick, 3 (three) gaps, 64 fences, 16 snowballs, 64 cookies, 64 sand, a kamikaze bow (which may or may not work depending on if i did the xml right), 1 arrow, and an opposite-team colored helmet
-core names are switched to mix it up
-wool rooms have a bunch of gaps and a kb I fish 
-includes a few """""executors""""" to spice the game up, all sounds because i couldn't figure out how to do anything else
-good for tiebreaking i'd imagine

map download/xml:https://goo.gl/K8gZ19
images:http://imgur.com/a/X5TiH
enjoy!
